text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Satsuki Sho and the weather is stormy. We head to the racecourse by taxi, but get stuck in traffic.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At this rate, we're going to be late for the race. Satono Diamond gets out of the taxi and runs the rest of the way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She suspects it's all due to her family jinx. However, it makes her all the more determined to become strong enough to break it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I head to the paddock as soon as I get to the racecourse. It looks like Satono Diamond made it in time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Now it's time to race in the Satsuki Sho!
